audit_title: OPS-01 Taxonomy Justification, Multidimensional Evidence Matrix, and Capability-Gap Audit
core_taxonomy_classification: B. REASONABLE ENGINEERING HYPOTHESIS REQUIRING VALIDATION
core_taxonomy_classification_justificati: The 7 core classes (BG, BS, LWA, IWs, OF, RF/RC, Eddy) are supported by direct physical oceanographic literature (Dim A) and established radar backscatter theory (Dim B), with direct/indirect look-alike mechanisms (Dim C). However, their direct empirical link to specific EXP-06 false alarms (Dim D) and their operational suppression efficacy in fusion (Dim E) remain unproven engineering hypotheses requiring validation.

capability_gap_justification.question: WHY DOES OPS-01 NEED TO EXIST?
capability_gap_justification.governance_rule: Rule 18: Every model must have a diagnosed reason for existing. Look-alike classes in another dataset do not justify a model.
capability_gap_justification.diagnosed_gap: EXP-06 was trained on petroleum slicks and achieves high precision on authentic oil, but exhibits false-positive sensitivity to low-backscatter natural anomalies (biogenic slicks, calm water, internal waves). Retraining or modifying EXP-06 risks catastrophic forgetting and invalidates its frozen benchmark baseline. OPS-01 is chartered to provide an independent look-alike recognition engine that detects these natural phenomena, enabling downstream multi-specialist fusion to suppress false alarms without altering the frozen oil detector.
capability_gap_justification.system_level_capability_gap: EXP-06 demonstrates a clean-water false-alarm capability gap.
capability_gap_justification.look_alike_attribution_status: Specific attribution of those false alarms to individual Li phenomena (BS, LWA, IWs, OF, RF, Eddy) is NOT ESTABLISHED and requires targeted evaluation.
capability_gap_justification.causal_attribution_prohibition: Never use CAUSE, ROOT CAUSE, or PROVEN SOURCE for individual Li classes until targeted empirical false-alarm benchmarking is executed under canonical preprocessing.
capability_gap_justification.clarification: OPS-01 is chartered as an architectural hypothesis. It is not currently demonstrated or proven to suppress false alarms in operational deployment.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Background Seawater
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Ambient open-ocean baseline matrix; provides essential negative class anchor.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Biological Slicks
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Phytoplankton/plankton monomolecular surfactant films damp short capillary waves via Marangoni effect; primary global look-alike.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Low Wind Area
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Surface wind speed < 2-3 m/s prevents Bragg ripple formation; radar backscatter drops to noise floor, producing large dark regions.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Oceanic Internal Waves
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Subsurface soliton packets modulate surface roughness; dark trough stripes create curved linear features resembling oil slicks.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Oceanic Front
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Water mass boundaries and current shears collect natural surfactants along convergence lines, mimicking weathered linear slicks.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Rainfall / Rain Cells
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Atmospheric precipitation downdrafts cause dark divergence footprints surrounded by turbulent bright borders.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Ocean Eddy
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Mesoscale/submesoscale vortices organize natural slicks into curved spiral arms.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Wind Streak
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Boundary layer roll vortices aligned with surface wind; provides wind direction context.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Pure Ocean Wave
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Open-ocean swell wave fields; provides ambient wave energy context.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Micro Convective Cells
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Honeycomb atmospheric convection patterns; contextual atmospheric stability indicator.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Atmospheric Front
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Synoptic meteorological fronts; step-change in wind field, contextual atmospheric indicator.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Sea Ice
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Grease/frazil ice dampens waves in polar seas; segregated to polar mode to prevent distorting open-ocean metrics.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Iceberg
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Calved glacial ice bodies (100% in WV mode); segregated to polar operating mode.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: Ships, offshore drilling platforms, aquaculture rafts, and wind turbines. Strictly designated 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects'; renaming to 'Vessel' is forbidden.

multidimensional_evidence_matrix.name: Mineral Oil Spill (Incidental Tag)
multidimensional_evidence_matrix.notes: DISQUALIFIED. 4 images, 1,702 pixels. Excluded from OPS training, oil evaluation, and ground truth.

iw_mode.grouping_basis: Parent Level-1 GRD Product Scene Stem
iw_mode.partition_rule: Partitioning MUST occur at parent scene stem level. Sibling slices cannot cross partitions.

wv_mode.partition_rule: Partitioning MUST occur at orbit-pass level. Sibling vignettes cannot cross partitions.

cross_dataset_leakage.confidence: MEDIUM (HIGH for Part-I dev test; UNKNOWN for firewalled Part-III)
cross_dataset_leakage.firewall_governance_rule: Rule 65: A benchmark firewall prevents evaluation, but therefore cannot establish zero overlap with the firewalled benchmark unless independent evidence exists.
